invariants.rationale: The method always returns either style.disabledKnobAfter or style.knobAfter, both likely to be non-null based on typical style resource provision.
By inspection, only these two values can ever be returned.
Ensures that only when the 'disabled' flag is set and 'disabledKnobAfter' is present does that specific drawable get returned.
If the 'disabled' condition is met, 'result' must be 'style.disabledKnobAfter'.
Ensures when 'disabled' is true but 'disabledKnobAfter' is null, method does not return the null value; otherwise, if disabled, result matches 'disabledKnobAfter'.
